status: OPEN obligations for rung 2. verify.py certifies the accounting (whole-bank volume, retained row identity, both paid moments on the 10^-18 grid, the 47-constraint assembly and the exclusion of the adjacent grid point, and an independent replica in PR208's convention). The items below are what a physical construction must additionally supply, and C1 is the one that has no precedent anywhere in the pins.

why_rung_2_and_not_higher.statement: Rung 1 (#219) already sits on the complex branch's ceiling, so no rung above it can be taken on the bit word at all.

numbers.bit_headroom_at_rung_1: 1.95e-5 of bit coarse saving above the complex budget, unspendable while the complex branch binds

why_rung_2_and_not_higher.consequence: every further rung starts by raising the complex supplier's own coarse saving; rung 2 does that by absorbing its rank-11 family and reaches the complex supplier's new ceiling C'/(1+C') = 7.082915705907269e-4 within one grid step.
why_rung_2_and_not_higher.grid_precision: PR193 publishes complex_saving = 219037/312500000 = 7.009184e-4, its value on the 10^-10 grid, 4.3859411e-11 below the 10^-18 certified paid moment of the same profile (700918443859411/10^18). The frontier certificate and rung 1 both price the certified moment and this package reproduces both exactly; the coarser field is priced as supplier_field.conservative_variant in certificate.json, where the complex branch ceiling already sits at rung 1.

obligations.name: complex-side bank construction and residual-type blocks
obligations.statement: Build the bank construction on the complex supplier: banks of width 66 hosting the rank-11 items, with the normalizer that sends each item's true residual projector to its assigned block, the per-bank block assignment (six rank-11 blocks per bank, since 66 = 6 x 11) and the hashed item-to-bank/offset map for all 531 three-copy banks (177 one copy). The pins contain no bank construction for the complex supplier: its certificate has no bank keys at all, and the only banked word in the pins is the bit word's entrance-gauge pack of PR205/PR206 (width 72, rank-60 exteriors, 6,116 banks).
obligations.why_it_is_the_blocker: The bit-side mechanism is specific to the width-72 bit word's entrance gauges; nothing in the queue banks complex-word dirt, so this is a new mechanism rather than an extension of an existing one.
obligations.reference_precedent: PR205 references/pr219-run1/references/pr205-packed.certificate.json: physical.banks with gauge_roles, distinct_gauges, copies and bank_controls; research/coordinated-frames-and-entrance-banks BANK-PROOF-PR200.md for the block/normalizer pattern.

obligations.statement: Re-run the complete formal-column checks on the complex word after the re-assignment: every source, target and dirty-register column over F2 and over the defining integers, with the rank-11 transitions realized by bank re-assignment instead of paid children, and the exact scalar program / lift certificate re-derived rather than compared as a container digest.

obligations.statement: Exact charts (integer kernel bases with fraction-free inverses and replayed elementary factors) for every new complex block frame, the incidence colouring of the new bank incidences, and distinct integer Gram/prime witnesses for every frame the new blocks use, with residual factors below the retained q bound.
obligations.reference_precedent: #219 R3; PR205's chart digest and colouring checks; banks.py (vendored) for the fraction-free inversion and two-colouring helpers.

obligations.name: complex moment-envelope parity
obligations.statement: Confirm that the paid moment envelope for the modified complex word is exactly the one priced here: retained three-copy stock 35,625 (one copy 11,875), deficit 3,960 (one copy 1,320), the retained child histogram of ledger.py's absorbed row, and no rare-class fallback on the complex side (the convention #219 uses there). Any completion child C1 introduces must re-enter the ledger and the kappa be recomputed.
obligations.reference_precedent: #219 R4; PR200's interval-moment engine as vendored by #219 (interval_moment.py).

obligations.name: inventory and provenance of the rank-11 family
obligations.statement: Enumerate the rank-11 items: for each of the 1,062 per-vertex children of the complex ledger's bin 11, the frame/chain occurrence it comes from, with a checked bijection onto the 3,186 three-copy occurrences and a proof that no other bin is touched. The pins contain no such inventory; the only occurrence inventory they hold is #219's bit-side inputs/absorbed-occurrences.json for the rank-22 bin, which is what makes #219's R1 a closed checklist.

claim_scope: This package certifies an accounting ledger and its exact price: the whole-bank volume condition, the retained row identity with the stock falling by the bank count, both complex paid moments with the adjacent 10^-18 grid point excluded, the unchanged 47-constraint assembly at the rung-2 budget with its adjacent point rejected, and an independent replica of the same ledger in PR208's pricing convention. The rung is NOT constructed: C1 has no precedent in the pins and C5 has no inventory. The kappa is therefore a priced, exactly certified target conditional on C1-C5 and on #219's inherited R1-R4, and it is not a completed finite witness or an unconditional multiplication theorem in any case.
